axes: Blender Z up, metres, front = -Y; FBX axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y, apply_unit_scale=True
pivot: root mesh of every asset: centre of the base on the ground (0, 0, 0)
palette: _lib/Look_Palette_v2.png (+ .json): UV0 inside the swatch cell; alpha = smoothness
description: Plan buildings of the trial region (look_v12_flat.json, x 440-960, y 360-870) built with the facade grammar of bible 7 - preview of the ProceduralBuilding roll-out
notes: One model per plan building of the trial region; colours by bible 7.5 (2.7 specials, 2.5 recipes by hash(id), 2.6 pairs, neighbour rule 12 m; panel blocks by balcony accent). Placement data: plan_buildings_v02.json.
Unity: position (plan x, 0, plan y), rotation Euler(0, unity_yaw, 0); the model front is local -Z.
The .blend shows the assets in rows along +X; every FBX has its root at the origin.
